from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json

# Parse the HTML
html = html = _input.first().json.body

soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')

# Find all media elements
media_elements = soup.find_all('div', class_='media')

# Create a list to store news data
news_data = []

# Extract data from each media element
for media in media_elements:
    # Extract title
    title_element = media.find('a', class_='subject')
    title = title_element.get('title') if title_element else title_element.text if title_element else ""
    if not title:
        title = media.find('a').get('title') if media.find('a') else "No title found"
    
    # Extract URL
    url_element = media.find('a', class_='subject')
    url = url_element.get('href') if url_element else ""
    if not url:
        url = media.find('a').get('href') if media.find('a') else ""
    
    # Extract category
    category_element = media.find('a', class_='type')
    category = category_element.text if category_element else "No category found"
    
    # Extract description
    description_element = media.find('h6', class_='description').find('a')
    description = description_element.text if description_element else "No description found"
    
    # Extract image URL
    image_element = media.find('img')
    image_url = image_element.get('src') if image_element else "No image found"
    
    # Extract time
    time_element = media.find('div', class_='time')
    time = time_element.text if time_element else "No time found"
    
    # Create a dictionary with the extracted data
    news_item = {
        "title": title,
        "url": url,
        "category": category,
        "description": description,
        "imageUrl": image_url,
        "time": time
    }
    
    news_data.append(news_item)

# Output as JSON
return news_data

import json

# 手動解析JSON數據
data = _input.first().json.data

# 創建人類可讀的格式，description只取前30字
human_readable = ""
for i, news in enumerate(data, 1):
    # 截取description的前30個字符，如果長度不足30則取全部
    short_desc = news['description'][:30] + "..." if len(news['description']) > 30 else news['description']
    
    human_readable += f"{i}. {news['title']}\n"
    human_readable += f"   {short_desc}\n"
    human_readable += f"   {news['url'].strip()}\n\n"

return [
  { "text": human_readable }
]
